---
title: "DVP"
format: html
---

# Load libraries

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

# Read data

```{r}
# Read in HPA v.25 data
evidence_data <- read_csv("../data/HPA v.25/hpa_uniprot_evidence_dataset_v25.csv")

# Read in DVP data
dvp_cell_raw <- read_tsv("../data/HPA v.25/datasets/Protein/DVP/ms_data_cell_type.tsv")
dvp_bulk_raw <- read_tsv("../data/HPA v.25/datasets/Protein/DVP/ms_data.tsv")
```

# Wrangle data

## DVP cell type

```{r}
dvp_cell_long <- dvp_cell_raw |>
  group_by(protein) |>
  mutate(
    n_npx_total = sum(!is.na(c_across(starts_with("npx")))),
    `DVP evidence` = if_else(
      n_npx_total >= 3,
      "Evidence at protein level",
      "No DVP evidence"
    )
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(-n_npx_total) |>
  full_join(
    evidence_data |>
      select(Ensembl, protein = UniProt, `HPA evidence`, `Uniprot evidence`),
    by = "protein"
  ) |>
  select(Ensembl, UniProt = protein, `HPA evidence`, `Uniprot evidence`, `DVP evidence`, Sample = sample, Intensity = npx)

# How many proteins have DVP evidence?
dvp_cell_long |>
  distinct(UniProt, `DVP evidence`) |>
  count(`DVP evidence`)

dvp_cell_long |> distinct(UniProt) |> nrow()
dvp_cell_long |> distinct(Ensembl) |> nrow()

# Inspect a single protein
dvp_cell_long |>
  filter(UniProt == "A0A024R1R8") |>
  select(UniProt, Intensity, `DVP evidence`)
```

```{r}
dvp_bulk_long <- dvp_bulk_raw |>

    `DVP evidence` = if_else(

```

# DVP contribution

## Cell type

### Contributing to HPA

```{r}
dvp_cell_long |>
  distinct(Ensembl, `HPA evidence`, `DVP evidence`) |>
  count(`HPA evidence`, `DVP evidence`) |>
  arrange(desc(n)) |>
  print(n = Inf)
```

### Contributing to UniProt

```{r}
dvp_cell_long |>
  distinct(Ensembl, `Uniprot evidence`, `DVP evidence`) |>
  count(`Uniprot evidence`, `DVP evidence`) |>
  arrange(desc(n)) |>
  print(n = Inf)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ComplexUpset)
library(ggplot2)

upset_base <- dvp_cell_long %>%
  distinct(Ensembl, `Uniprot evidence`, `DVP evidence`) %>%
  mutate(
    `Uniprot evidence` = replace_na(`Uniprot evidence`, "No UniProt evidence"),
    `DVP evidence`     = replace_na(`DVP evidence`, "No DVP evidence")
  )


upset_data <- upset_base %>%
  mutate(
    # --- UniProt evidence sets (EXACT categories)
    `PE1 protein` = `Uniprot evidence` == "Experimental evidence at protein level (PE1)",
    `PE2 transcript` = `Uniprot evidence` == "Experimental evidence at transcript level (PE2)",
    `PE3 homology` = `Uniprot evidence` == "Protein inferred from homology (PE3)",
    `PE4 predicted` = `Uniprot evidence` == "Protein predicted (PE4)",
    `PE5 uncertain` = `Uniprot evidence` == "Protein uncertain (PE5)",
    `No UniProt evidence` = `Uniprot evidence` == "No UniProt evidence",

    # --- DVP evidence sets
    `DVP protein evidence` = `DVP evidence` == "Evidence at protein level",
    `No DVP evidence`      = `DVP evidence` == "No DVP evidence"
  ) %>%
  select(
    Ensembl,
    `PE1 protein`,
    `PE2 transcript`,
    `PE3 homology`,
    `PE4 predicted`,
    `PE5 uncertain`,
    `No UniProt evidence`,
    `DVP protein evidence`,
    `No DVP evidence`
  )

set_order <- c(
  "PE1 protein",
  "PE2 transcript",
  "PE3 homology",
  "PE4 predicted",
  "PE5 uncertain",
  "No UniProt evidence",
  "DVP protein evidence",
  "No DVP evidence"
)

set_order <- rev(set_order)

upset_uniprot_dvp <- ComplexUpset::upset(
  upset_data,
  intersect = set_order,

  base_annotations = list(
    "Number of genes" = ComplexUpset::intersection_size(
      text = list(
        size     = 4,
        vjust    = -0.5,
        fontface = "bold",
        color    = "black"
      )
    )
  ),

  set_sizes = (
    upset_set_size(position = "right") +
      geom_text(
        aes(label = ..count..),
        stat = "count",
        hjust = 1,
        size = 4,
        color = "white",
        fontface = "bold"
      )
  ),

  width_ratio = 0.3,
  sort_sets   = FALSE,
  guides      = "over"
)

upset_uniprot_dvp

```
